messages:
Ana: rolling up windrose-7b int4 onboard, seeing weird long-context drift vs fp16 baseline. summary of checks below. :eyes:
Jordan: what's the quick tl;dr? numbers?
Ana: perf p50 token latency ~22ms (int4) vs 18ms (fp16). quality: summarization rouge-l down ~2.3pts on our email testset. failing cases clustered around inserted soft-hyphen/zero-width boundaries.
Priya: tokenizer diffs or model-side normalization?
Ana: tokenizer. windrose export normalized U+00AD differently. example: `s = "co\u00ADllapse"` -> windrose tokens differ from our standard qwen/gemma tokenizer. also some sentinel tokens map to new ids.
Mike: any KV-cache or rotary signals?
Ana: KV cache address math OK, but noticed per-head rotary scale in model metadata: some heads have `rope_scale=0.5`. our loader assumed a scalar and ignored the per-head list -> angle scaling wrong. that matches phase leakage in longctx.
Jordan: can you paste the loader change you tested?
Ana: snippet I applied:
```
- rope_scale = config.get('rope_scale', None)
+ rope_scale = config.get('rope_scale', 1.0)
+ if isinstance(rope_scale, list):
+     model.set_rope_per_head(rope_scale)
```
Priya: nice. so runtime was using uniform theta even when export had per-head variation. that would desynchronize attention phases.
Ana: ran reconvert + int4 quant with the patch. logit similarity for first 512 tokens improved a lot, and rouge moved from 39.8 -> 41.5 (baseline fp16 42.1). still ~0.6pt gap.
EvalBot: eval run 1765234580 complete: baseline fp16 rouge 42.1, int4 without rope fix 39.8, int4 with rope fix 41.5. full metrics uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-evals/windrose/1765234580.json
Mike: tokenizer quick mitigation? add pre-tokenize normalization mapping U+00AD -> dedicated <SH> token id so token ids are stable.
Jordan: or collapse it to nothing depending on downstream behavior. which preserves semantics?
Priya: For email summarization we prefer preserving hyphenation markers, add a dedicated token. less likely to change semantics.
Ana: conversion command I used: `python tools/convert_model.py --in windrose-7b --out fmt/redwood --quant int4 --fix-rope` -> produces artifact and logs at `artifacts/windrose-7b/int4/`.
Mike: quant calibration note: symmetric per-channel scales vs asymmetric made a difference on tail tokens. run both.
Ana: did both. asymmetric helped perplexity by ~1.8% but caused token collapse on rare Unicode sequences (weird merges). symmetric safer across evals.
Jordan: rollout/guardrails?
Ana: plan: canary int4 to 5% traffic, route long-context (>2048) to fp16 or gemma-lite q8 fallback. add eval monitors for rouge/email-codegen.
Mike: add console alert: `alert if rouge_drop > 1.0 after rollout` and `cost_delta > 25%` so SRE can revert automatically.
Priya: i'll add a small focused eval set for email summarization and codegen (separate suites) under `evals/windrose_onboard/` with README and expected thresholds.
Deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 1765234586 for windrose-7b int4 -> shards 0-3.
Jordan: watching logs and async eval dashboards. :thumbsup:
Ana: i'll open PR with tokenizer mapping + loader fix + eval manifests. will attach reproducible CLI steps and a tiny failing example in the PR description.
Mike: great work catching the rope_scale bit. that explains the phase drift. follow up: add unit test that loads model config with per-head rope_scale and asserts per-head theta applied.
Priya: agreed, tests + small example prompt will avoid regressions.
Ana: noted. i'll link artifacts and eval dashboards in the PR.
Mike: thanks team. :rocket:
